title: look input
description: Set ids or bounds, not both. With neither, look renders your current focus, or the whole Space.

bounds.description: [x, y, width, height] in the reading Agent's coordinates. x and y are the top-left corner.

coord.description: One coordinate in the reading Agent's own integer coordinate space for this Space. Its origin never moves (ADR-0007).

length.description: A width, height or gap in the same units as coord.

space_name.description: A Space's short, stable name, such as 'auth-plan'.

target_ref.description: An Element ID or a Mark ID from a Send Bundle.
